trap.label: will após if
trap.wrong: If the file will be incomplete, it is rejected.
trap.right: If a file is incomplete, it is rejected.
trap.why: No português o verbo após “se” pode ficar no futuro do subjuntivo. Em inglês, depois de if, use presente, não will.

mcq.q: If a file ___ incomplete, it is rejected.
If I were rich, I ___ travel.

fix.wrong: If it will rain, we stay home.
fix.right: If it rains, we will stay home.

fix.wrong: If I would be rich, I would travel.
fix.right: If I were rich, I would travel.

fix.wrong: Unless you don’t pay, we stop.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com unless: “If you don’t pay, we stop.”
Reescreva no zero: “If water is heated, it boils.” (heat/water)
rewrite.answer: If you heat water, it boils.

rewrite.prompt: Use if: “I’m not rich, so I don’t travel.” (If I… )
rewrite.answer: If I were rich, I would travel.
